description_en: Queries the health check status of a load balancing instance listener
description_zh: 查询负载均衡实例监听的健康检查状态
name: GetListenerHealthStatus

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether a next query token exists. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, no next query exists.
If NextToken has a return value, the value indicates the token for the next query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paginated query. Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~1000，默认值为 20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to skip in a paging query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，跳过的条目数
parameters.name: skip

fields.help_en:
The name of the dynamic query condition. You can specify one or more names for the query. Valid values:
Status: the health check status.
ReasonCode: the detailed reason when the status is abnormal.
ServerId: the backend server ID.
ServerIp: the backend server IP address
fields.help_zh:
动态查询条件名称，可选择一个或者多个名称进行查询。取值范围：
Status：健康检查状态。
ReasonCode：Status 为异常状态时的详细原因。
ServerId：后端服务器ID。
ServerIp：后端服务器IP地址
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The list of values for the dynamic query condition. You can add up to 20 values at a time
fields.help_zh: 动态查询条件的值列表。一次最多添加20个值
fields.name: values

parameters.help_en: The list of dynamic query conditions. You can add up to 20 dynamic query conditions at a time
parameters.help_zh: 动态查询条件列表。一次最多添加20个动态查询条件
parameters.name: filter

ListenerHealthStatus.description_en: The list of health check statuses for server groups associated with the listener
ListenerHealthStatus.description_zh: 监听的服务器组健康检查状态列表

items.description_en: The health check status structure for a server group associated with the listener
items.description_zh: 监听的服务器组健康检查状态结构

ServerGroupInfos.description_en: The list of server group information

HealthCheckEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether health check is enabled. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
HealthCheckEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启健康检查。取值：
true：开启。
false：关闭

Reason.description_en: The detailed reason when Status is abnormal
Reason.description_zh: Status为异常状态时的详细原因

ReasonCode.description_en:
The detailed reason when Status is abnormal. Valid values:

CONNECT_TIMEOUT: The load balancing health check timed out when establishing a connection to the backend server.
CONNECT_FAIL: The load balancing health check failed to establish a connection to the backend server.
RECV_TIMEOUT: The load balancing health check timed out when waiting to accept a response from the backend server.
CONNECT_INTERRUPT: The load balancing health check connection to the backend server encountered a break.
HTTP_CODE_NOT_MATCH: The response code received from the backend server during the load balancing HTTP health check did not match the expected return code.
HTTP_INVALID_HEADER: The response received from the backend server during the load balancing HTTP health check had a format fault
ReasonCode.description_zh:
Status为异常状态时的详细原因，取值：

CONNECT_TIMEOUT：负载均衡健康检查时向后端服务器建立连接超时。
CONNECT_FAIL：负载均衡健康检查时向后端服务器建立连接失败。
RECV_TIMEOUT：负载均衡健康检查时从后端服务器接收响应超时。
CONNECT_INTERRUPT：负载均衡健康检查与后端服务器连接中断。
HTTP_CODE_NOT_MATCH：负载均衡健康 HTTP 检查时从后端服务器接收的响应码与预期配置返回码不一致。
HTTP_INVALID_HEADER：负载均衡健康 HTTP 检查时从后端服务器接收响应格式错误

Status.description_en:
The health check status of the backend server. Valid values:

Initial: Initialization in progress. The load balancing instance has health check configured, but no data is available.
Unhealthy: Unhealthy. The backend server has consecutively reported an unhealthy status.
Unused: Not used.
Unavailable: Not enabled. Health check is not enabled.
Healthy: Healthy. The health check is normal
Status.description_zh:
后端服务器健康检查状态。取值：

Initial：初始化中，表示负载均衡实例配置了健康检查，但查不到数据。
Unhealthy：异常，表示连续上报不健康的状态。
Unused：未使用;
Unavailable：未开启，表示未开启健康检查；
Healthy：健康检查正常；

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries per page in a paginated query. Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 20
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~1000，默认值为 20

NextToken.description_en:
Specifies whether a next query token exists. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, no next query exists.
If NextToken has a return value, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned under the current query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 本次请求条件下的数据总量
